description: Cody Reading helps reading specialists, tutors, classroom teachers, and interventionists create and evaluate decodable stories aligned to UFLI Foundations lessons. Users can find relevant UFLI lesson numbers, generate lesson-aligned stories from a topic, revise generated or pasted stories while preserving lesson alignment, and analyze existing passages for decodability. Results render in an interactive story viewer with a decodability score, word-category highlighting, challenge-word review, and a printable PDF link.

defaultPrompt: Create a decodable story for UFLI lesson 111
